operator_rule: 2026-11-07 — Finviz cache first, a fresh Schwab/Alpaca/moomoo quote second, the stored mark only flagged stale. Never yfinance as a price.
rule: This file is a SHRINK-ONLY ratchet, enforced by tests/test_no_yfinance_writers_lq1679_20261109.py. Every module under scripts/ (archive excluded) that imports yfinance must appear in `allowed` with its kind. A module that is not listed fails the guard; a listed module that no longer imports yfinance also fails (delete the entry); nothing may be added to `kind: price`; and each `kind: price_read` module is a follow-up row that must be fixed and removed, not re-baselined.

kinds.non_price: imports yfinance but never takes a price from it (fundamentals, earnings, dividends, sector, holdings, expense ratios, descriptions).
kinds.derived: takes a yfinance price but stores only a non-price artifact computed from it (an indicator, a return, a beta, a yield, a backtest series). Still a yfinance price read; lower priority than price_read.
kinds.price_read: hands a yfinance price to a caller, a surface, a plan, an alert or a price-bearing store. These are the LQ-1679 follow-up rows.
kinds.price: FORBIDDEN and must stay empty. A module that writes or serves a yfinance price as the price was the defect LQ-1679 fixed in the three store writers.
